Full-frame cine prime, T1.3. Image circle 46.3mm = fullFrame per POS-D28 (Sigma markets as LF-covering: ARRI ALEXA LF Open Gate / VistaVision, which is the FF class). Part of the initial 8-lens Aizu Prime release, PL mount. Prime: zoomRatio 1, maxApertureTele null. HFOV cross-check: 36mm-FF model reproduces Sigma's published Full Frame AOV exactly (25mm = 71.5 deg). Source: sigma-global.com per-lens spec page. Staged 2026-09-05 (Aizu-arc).
